scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w server" "npx wait-on http-get://127.0.0.1:3001/api/health -t 120000 -i 300 && npm run dev -w web"
scripts.dev:stack: concurrently -k -n server,bot -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npx wait-on http-get://127.0.0.1:3001/api/health -t 120000 -i 400 && npm run dev -w telegram-bot"
scripts.build: npm run build -w web && npm run build -w server
